intent: Portable, deterministic project-local governance preserving explicit project authority and independently verified scope success.

criteria.contracts: Seven focused checks: project binding, scope/intent/criteria and result semantics; capacity validation does not activate workers.
criteria.actions: Nine actual-Git/recorded-adapter tests: plan/apply, instruction freshness including quality policy, authority, exact readback, uncertain writes and idempotency.
criteria.review: One real committed synthetic behavior change: full source-bound policy, 39 review conditions, missing intent proof refused, check fails before fix and passes afterwards, compact bundle retains full selected leaves and unknown usage.
criteria.cli: Six actual command/baseline/scope/loop checks, including automatic checkout-bound scope creation and readable validation without hash output, missing policy, foreign/stale source and typed loop routes.
criteria.loop: Six focused state-machine checks cover initial build, defect repair, complete verification, distinct scope/oracle/environment/blocked routing, retry/time budgets, terminal records and source mismatch. A two-iteration local pilot failed on subtraction, routed to build, passed after addition and routed to report.
criteria.installer: Four lifecycle groups on empty/existing projects: readable pending plans without human digests, install/verify/no-op, changed release/adapter refusal, upgrade, rollback/remove and reversal, conflicts, integrity, duplicate skills, interrupted recovery. Installed actions/review sample reuses nine checks.
criteria.worker: Thirty-six focused checks cover explicit provider/model configuration, inert package defaults, patch/native-child behavior, scope/attempt bounds, canonical-runner consistency, public wrappers and the actual bubblewrap boundary. No paid worker trial was run.
criteria.skills: 39 canonical/native skill files structurally validated, including the self-verifying canonical skill and native router. Prior session proof discovered the native session skill, read its full leaf, reported correct source and incomplete task review, and confirmed disabled/capacity-two defaults.
criteria.package: Explicit 98-file portable path inventory, immutable source provenance, a release-level branding regression check and the retained third-party MIT notice; no application source or private history.

leadAssessment: Local artifacts meet recorded portable-core and installation intent. A command pass or valid record does not prove application acceptance. Actual release/publication and first adoption remain separate.
remaining: Approve private destination creation and initial main branch publication/release
Read back exact published commit/manifest and required CI
Separate scoped approval for first real repository adoption
noClaims: No new provider setup or worker activation
